Name: The Hedgewitchs Almanac
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[center][b][size=6]🌙🌿 The Hedgewitch’s Almanac 🐸✨[/size][/b][/center]
Bring more witchcraft, herbalism, and cozy magic to Stardew Valley! [b]The Hedgewitch’s Almanac[/b] adds herbs, flowers, remedies, recipes, magical objects, and helpful guides to discover at your own pace. 🧙‍♀️🌸
Tend a witchy garden, forage around the Valley, brew something restorative, or take a broom ride with a tiny frog familiar. There’s always another bit of magic waiting! 🧹🐸
[heading]🌷 Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Herbal crops and seeds:[/b] Grow Moonmint, Sunpetal, Witchroot, and other useful herbs. Find seeds at Pierre’s and discover which plants grow each season. 🌱[/*]
[*][b]Wild herb gathering:[/b] Search the Valley for seasonal herbs, with special finds tied to weather and locations. 🍄[/*]
[*][b]Herbalism and remedies:[/b] Gather ingredients, brew remedies and elixirs, and build your herbalist knowledge. Remedies can help with activities like mining and healing. 🧪[/*]
[*][b]Flowers, teas, and decor:[/b] Grow unique flowers, give or sell them, brew drinkable teas with custom buffs, and craft a decorative wildflower vase. 💐🫖[/*]
[*][b]Apothecary Brewing Station:[/b] Brew herbal remedies, elixirs, teas, and cozy foods at a dedicated station. 🧉[/*]
[*][b]Personalized welcome letter:[/b] New saves receive one letter on Spring 1 with the guidebook, Field Journal, and broom. Existing saves missing any of these items receive a one-time catch-up letter. Pierre also sells them. 💌📚[/*]
[*][b]Almanac and Field Journal:[/b] Learn about the mod, find herb locations, and keep track of remedies, recipes, flowers, and Herbalism progress. 📖[/*]
[*][b]Rideable witchy broom:[/b] Travel around the farm or Valley on a rustic, cottagecore broom with a little frog passenger. 🧹🐸[/*]
[*][b]Functional crystal ball:[/b] Check the day’s weather, pass a short stretch of time, summon rain, and enjoy magical sparkles during its time-passing effect. 🔮✨🌧️[/*]
[*][b]Tarot readings:[/b] Draw one card per day. Readings can bring helpful or challenging buffs, and Fortune cards can affect Pierre’s prices for the day. 🃏🌙[/*]
[*][b]Marshlight Frog Familiar:[/b] Wear this little companion as a hat accessory and bring froggy witchcraft along on your adventures. 🐸🎩[/*]
[*][b]Quests and progression:[/b] Help villagers with herbal errands and build your Herbalism knowledge through gathering, harvesting, and brewing. 🍃[/*]
[/list]The mod is designed to be [b]compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], but SVE is[b][u] not[/u][/b] required. 🌾
[heading]✨ Future updates[/heading]
I plan to keep updating the mod as much as possible, with more cozy witchy features over time. Future ideas include additional herbs, remedies, recipes, quests, and magical interactions. I’ll share more as new features are ready! 🌟
[heading]🪄 Requirements and credits[/heading]
[b]SMAPI is required[/b] to run this mod. Install it from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url].
[b]Credits:[/b] Stardew Valley modding framework and support by the SMAPI team. Mod created by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b]. 🌸
